name: handbrake-mcp
description: Professional HandBrake MCP server for video transcoding with batch processing, watch folders, and real-time progress tracking
long_description: A comprehensive MCP server that provides professional video transcoding capabilities using HandBrake CLI. Features include batch processing, watch folder automation, real-time progress tracking, custom presets, and extensive configuration options for enterprise-grade video processing workflows.
